description: Before you quote an Orb Studio index (Consensus barometer, World Hallucination Index), see how much it depends on the site's own modelling choices: the index recomputed without each radar, without each keyword, with only the top headlines and with mixed headlines counted differently. Returns value, low-high bounds, median, verdict (robust / sensitive / fragile) and the choices that move it most. No AI. In honour of Edward E. Leamer (1944-2025), author of 'Let's Take the Con Out of Econometrics'.
name: get_leamer
title: Leamer sensor: how fragile is an Orb Studio index? (extreme bounds)
